name: match-ribbons
title: Match ribbons
description: Each match group draws its left records and right records as cards in two columns, joined by ribbons: one to one, one to many, or many to one. A card with no ribbon has no partner.
needs: Records that carry `left` and `right` as arrays of lines ({ key, name, ...fields }). A numeric measure shows the amount on each card. Reads best with up to a few dozen groups.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: {left} on the left, {right} on the right. A ribbon joins what was matched: one to one, one to several, or several to one. A card with no ribbon has no partner.

options.name: attentionOnly
options.description: Start with the groups that agree (exact and within tolerance) faded out, so only what needs attention stands out.
